description: Performance budget spec contract — validates Core Web Vitals thresholds, CI enforcement, and Lighthouse configuration

rules.description: coreWebVitals must be an object if declared
ciAction must be 'fail', 'warn', or 'block' — never 'none' or absent
CLS.good must be a decimal < 1.0 — CLS is a unitless score, not milliseconds
lighthouseRuns must be >= 3 when lighthouseThresholds is declared
FID (First Input Delay) is deprecated — use INP (Interaction to Next Paint) instead
